description: Search tracked Amazon UK listings for CPUs, GPUs, RAM, motherboards and storage. Prices are in pence. Returns up to 10 results with current price, stock state, a product URL and buyUrl. Use this to answer "what does X cost" and "what is the cheapest Y". Give the user buyUrl when they want to buy: never rebuild an Amazon link from the ASIN.

brand.description: Restrict to one or more brands, e.g. ["Corsair"].

category.description: Restrict to one or more categories. Storage spans hdd, ssd, nvme, external and usb.

maxPrice.description: Maximum current price in pence, e.g. 15000 for £150.

query.description: Free-text match against the product name, e.g. "DDR5" or "RTX 5080".

sort.description: Result ordering. Defaults to price_asc (cheapest first).

name: search_products
title: Search PC components
